Introduction

ChaeWon is a South Korean singer and dancer under MODHAUS.

On July 17, 2023, ChaeWon was announced as a contestant on the SBS survival show "Universe Ticket". She was eliminated during the second round, in the fourth episode.

ChaeWon was introduced as the twenty-first member of the girl group tripleS on April 1, 2024. She debuted with tripleS on May 8, 2024, with the album "ASSEMBLE24".

As a member of tripleS, ChaeWon was placed in the sub-unit Glow, Hatchi!, Alphie, and Sun.
